adjudication.depicted_input: BioMedGPT-10B multimodal fine-tuning interface showing molecule and protein inputs encoded, aligned through modality adaptors, and inserted into the BioMedGPT-LM prompt interface as model-facing multimodal representations.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is defensible because it visibly depicts the route-specific fine-tuning inputs for the molecule and protein alignment routes: source objects, their modality encoders, and the immediate model-facing prompt/interface into BioMedGPT-LM. Under atlas rules, training/fine-tuning inputs are valid, and the model box is not mandatory beyond the clearly shown interface. It does not support the separate biomedical QA text-only fine-tuning route, but it validly supports the two multimodal fine-tuning routes from the same paper.
